status_note: Preregistered 16-round greedy hillclimb continuation from Round-1 champion (matroid-2lp:traced-anchored, 2.065 Tbitops on Run50) across Phase 1 (sieve/factorization/graph), Phase 2 (sparse LA), and Phase 3 (multi-pattern F4 descent) until >= 5 consecutive orthogonal frontier hypotheses stall under the frozen 1.0% 4-seed mean bitop/v1 acceptance rule. Independently qualified by frozen /tmp/immutable_jv_graph_ic_hillclimb_qualify.

greedy_promotion_rule.metric: mean observed_bitops (bitop/v1) across all 4 frozen seeds [389, 101, 211, 307] at p = 1009
greedy_promotion_rule.completeness_gate: verified == true and matches_planted_truth == true on 4/4 seeds, with foreign_hook_calls == 0
greedy_promotion_rule.stall_definition: Any round with 4/4 valid solves whose 4-seed mean observed_bitops fails to improve over the incumbent champion by >= 1.0% (delta_pct > -1.0%) is classified as STALL; the incumbent champion is retained as the base configuration for subsequent rounds.
greedy_promotion_rule.stopping_criterion: Evaluate the complete 16-round schedule R0..R15, confirming >= 5 consecutive STALL rounds across orthogonal Phase-1/2/3 frontier hypotheses.
